request.question: Can I work remotely on Wednesday if I have a manager's approval?

sources.title: RAG-005 Employee Handbook
sources.content: Remote Work Policy. Employees may work remotely on Tuesday and Thursday. Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are office days unless a manager approves an exception.

sources.title: RAG-005 Employee Handbook
sources.content: Expense Policy. Employees must submit expense receipts within 10 calendar days of purchase. Manager approval is required for any single expense above 500 dollars.
